stages.name: implement
evidence: Issue #227 transitioned status:ready -> status:proposed -> status:in-progress after the independent proposal approval; WIP cap remains respected.

Implementation commit 12f17b2 adds DomusMind.Mcp, official SDK Streamable HTTP registration, empty tools/list catalog, configured Origin validation, actual API route composition with /mcp SPA fallback exclusion, Docker/solution integration, and focused SDK-client and architecture tests.

CI-equivalent restore, Release solution build, complete Release solution test, API publish, and Docker image build passed. The API project run passed 24 tests including the MCP endpoint-composition and dependency-boundary tests; PostgreSQL-backed Infrastructure tests passed all 59 tests with the three integration tests enabled.

Architecture contract check passed; markdownlint passed across 31 docs; ProductShape architecture citation verification found 81 current citations, no stale/tampered/unresolved citations or errors, and 59 existing draft provenance warnings.

Dependency scans still report baseline advisories: Microsoft.Kiota.Abstractions 1.17.1 high (API/Infrastructure transitive), MessagePack 2.5.302 moderate (AppHost), http-cache-semantics high (public-site lockfile), and KaTeX low (ArcShape snapshot lockfile). DomusMind.Mcp itself has no vulnerable package; the remaining findings require explicit owner security disposition. Docker also reported legacy-builder deprecation and the existing large frontend bundle advisory.

Plan deviation recorded: the MCP contract and boundary tests are hosted in DomusMind.Api.Tests rather than a standalone DomusMind.Mcp.Tests project so they can exercise the real API composition and controller routes.

The proposed model remains unchanged: the host exposes no household capability; OAuth provider placement, household authorization, and production MCP tools remain deferred to their planned follow-on issues.

Live runtime verification against the built Docker image passed at 2026-10-20 05:23 UTC. A current-protocol tools/list request with configured Origin returned 200 and an empty catalog; a path-bearing dot-segment Origin returned 403; current-protocol GET /mcp returned 405 without SPA content; existing REST ping returned 200.
